title: RAVine: Reality-Aligned Evaluation for Agentic Search
base_benchmarks: TREC Deep Learning Track (DL21, DL22, and DL23)
findings: In a case study on the varied views of euthanasia, the Qwen3-32B model successfully identified religion as a key factor. It correctly searched for and synthesized information on the perspectives of multiple religions, including Christianity, Islam, Buddhism, and Hinduism, incorporating these details into a structured, long-form report. This demonstrates the model's capability to handle complex queries involving religious topics by retrieving and integrating relevant information.
